paragraphs.text: Brigone is a human soldier from Theros .

Brigone is a light-skinned human soldier with blue hair who wears brown armor, a white skirt, and a green cape. She wields a golden sword and fights for Meletis with great faith in the gods. She has talked of how gods do more for soldiers than training and studies. She has been quoted observing an Anvilwrought Raptor in flight and striking, along with advice for fighting Cyclops by keeping them thinking to prevent its quick strikes.
